Shri Naval Kishor Gupta - Public Prosecutor for respon
2. This fourth application under section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/under section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 22.07.2023 in connection with Crime No.249/2023 registered at Police Station Badarwas, District Shivpuri (M.P.)
for offence under Sections 366, 376 (D), 392, 506 of IPC and Section 11/13 of MPDVPK Act.
3. Third application filed by the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 12.07.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.No. 27018/2024.
Since the Hon'ble Judge who had passed the previous order has been transferred, therefore, this present application has come before this Court.
4. In view of the fact that DNA report is against the applicant, no case is made out for taking a contrary view in the matter.
Accordingly, the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:19653 2 MCRC-36546-2024 application fails and is hereby dismissed.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE AK/-
